description: rolling_release.updateRollingReleaseConfig (PATCH /v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release/config) has no requestBody in the spec, so UpdateRollingReleaseConfigRequest generates with only path/query members and the operation cannot send its configuration. Live-verified: PATCH with {enabled:true, advancementType, stages:[{targetPercentage, requireApproval?, duration?}], canaryResponseHeader?} 200s and writes the config (GET echoes target/stages/canaryResponseHeader); PATCH {enabled:false} 200s and clears it ({rollingRelease:null}). Add the requestBody so the flattened request carries the body members.

enabled.description: Whether rolling releases are enabled for the project. `false` clears the configuration (equivalent to DELETE).

advancementType.description: How the rollout advances between stages: `automatic` (per-stage duration) or `manual-approval`.

stages.description: An array of all the stages required during a deployment release. The final stage must have targetPercentage: 100.

targetPercentage.description: The percentage of traffic to serve to the canary deployment (0-100)

requireApproval.description: Whether or not this stage requires manual approval to proceed

duration.description: Duration in minutes for automatic advancement to the next stage

linearShift.description: Whether to linearly shift traffic over the duration of this stage

canaryResponseHeader.description: Whether requests served by the canary deployment should return a header indicating a canary was served.
